translation:
Dang gui (當歸, washed in wine), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍, stir-fried), cooked rehmannia (熟地), psoralea (補骨脂), trogopterus dung (五靈脂), broad saussurea (廣木香), lycium root bark (地骨皮), saposhnikovia (防風, each five qian), frankincense (乳香, oil removed clean), myrrh (沒藥, oil removed clean), melon-seed dragon's blood (瓜兒血竭, each one qian)
Above, cut together in one place; use five qian of the root bark of the night-flowering silk tree (夜合花樹根皮), put it together into a large wine pot, add distilled liquor (燒酒) and boil together for the time of one incense stick (一炷香), then take it out and take it warm. <ins>Blood-Stopping Pain-Settling Flesh-Generating Powder (止血定痛生肌散)</ins> Treats conditions of injury and the like, with excessive loss of blood, or where attacking and reducing methods have caused depletion of qi and blood, with aversion to cold, fever, and vexation and agitation. Frankincense (乳香, oil removed clean), myrrh (沒藥, oil removed clean), dragon bone (龍骨, each three qian), dragon's blood (血竭, two qian), yellow lead (黃丹, sublimed, five qian), fragrant angelica dahurica (香白芷, two and a half qian), soft gypsum (軟石膏, calcined to remove fire toxicity, one liang), borneol (潮腦, a little)
Grind all together into fine powder, store in a porcelain vessel; sprinkle it on the affected area each time to stop pain and generate flesh.
